entities.summary: Brahim Asloum is a French amateur boxer. He held the WBA light flyweight title from 2007 to 2009. Asloum won the Light Flyweight Gold medal at the 2000 Summer Olympics. His Olympic win was France's first Olympic gold medal in boxing in 64 years.
